user.title: Connect parkrun
user.description: Enter the barcode ID from your parkrun barcode. No parkrun password is required — statistics come from your public results page.

data_description.athlete_id: Your barcode number, for example A1234567 or 1234567.
data_description.country: Choose the parkrun website you normally use. Athlete IDs are global, but results are served from the country sites.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach parkrun. Try again later.
error.invalid_athlete_id: Enter a numeric athlete ID, optionally prefixed with A.
error.not_found: No public results page was found for that athlete ID and country.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs.

abort.already_configured: This parkrun athlete is already configured.

latest_first_timer.name: Latest run was a first timer
